front: Melting and boiling points of pure water?
Why does temperature stay constant while melting or boiling?
back: Energy breaks bonds between particles instead of increasing their kinetic energy.
The escape of the more energetic particles from a liquid's surface.
The fastest particles leave, so the average kinetic energy of the rest falls.
Higher temperature, larger surface area, moving air.
Boiling: at the boiling point, throughout, bubbles. Evaporation: any temperature, surface only, cools.

front: Effect of impurities on melting and boiling points?
back: Impurities lower the melting point and raise the boiling point.

front: Effect of pressure on the boiling point?
back: Higher pressure raises it; lower pressure (high altitude) lowers it.
